Hi Alex / Marta — great to hear the plan and thanks for the details.

Quick responses up front:
- We can size a dedicated pool that meets your p99 target with margin; preliminary estimate is 6 x A100-equivalent for steady-state (~70M tokens/day) with ability to burst to ~10 nodes during peak windows. Exact SKU mix depends on average sequence length and your batching profile.
- Pricing: 12-month vs 24-month primarily changes the unit discount (24mo ~10–14% deeper discount vs 12mo). We can provide precise per-token/unit pricing once we lock SKU mix.
- GPU spike protection: we offer two mechanisms — a fixed discount ladder tied to committed spend, and an indexation clause that caps passthrough adjustments to +/- X% with a review trigger. For large enterprise >$500k ARR we can negotiate a bespoke protection (escrow/credit).

I'll pull together a quick mutual action plan and a capacity breakpoint spreadsheet that shows commit bands and recommended discount tiers. Looping Karthik and Marcus to advise on pricing levers and ops implications.

Next steps: I'll send the MA plan + breakpoint sheet by EOD Monday and propose a Thursday slot for 30 minutes.

Best,

Proposed commercial sketch (draft):
- Band A (anchor): 6 A100-eq nodes, 12mo -> list + 8% discount
- Band B (scale): 10 A100-eq nodes, 12mo -> list + 14% discount OR 24mo -> list + 22% discount
- Protection: If GPU market costs increase >20% vs baseline, allow a single-mechanism credit (up to 7% credit) or an indexation pass-through capped at +/- 12% with right to escalate.

Questions:
1) Karthik — what discount ceiling can you approve for a strategic account (Peregrine looks product-led, could scale quickly)?
2) Marcus — any ops constraints on bursting from 6->10 nodes in H1; does this require a dedicated pool re-provision or can autoscaling handle it?
3) Sean — finance/credit: would a 24mo schedule with deeper discount need a revenue deferral or special invoice terms?

Need quick answers so I can finalize the MA and send to Peregrine on Wednesday.

Thanks — Naomi

Naomi — high level guidance from pricing committee:
- For strategic mid-market accounts (anticipated < $1.5M committed ARR in year 1), leaders can approve up to 16% off list for 12-months and up to 25% for 24-months with Sales VP signoff. Anything beyond 25% requires CSO approval.
- For GPU cost-protection: finance prefers an indexed clause (quarterly true-up) with a floor/ceiling to avoid open-ended passthroughs. Approve up to a 10% credit cap in exceptional cases, but that should be tied to milestone triggers.

Recommend we present the two-band pricing with explicit path: Sales Manager sign-off for <=16% (12mo) / <=22% (24mo), VP for up to 25%, CSO for exceptions. That keeps approvals tight and predictable.

Karthik
VP, Commercial Strategy
